From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Rivera <security@bluewaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG artifacts consolidation and verification request

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking time with us last week. As we work to complete the SIG questionnaire for Bluewater Health, we wanted to consolidate the set of artifacts you typically request so we can provide everything in one secure handoff and confirm scope/format expectations.

Can you confirm Bluewater's acceptance of the following items (redaction allowed where noted):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) — we can provide manager-level or full report depending on your process.
- Pen test summary (executive-level, redacted vulnerability details) — full report available under NDA if needed.
- ISO statements / attestation letters (ISO 27001 certificate)
- Security overview deck (pptx) describing controls, network segmentation, data flow diagrams (high level)

Target timeline: if possible we would like to upload the artifacts by end of week (Fri 23 Jul). If you need a different cadence, let me know.

Also, any specific filename conventions or markups you prefer on the SOC/pen-test (e.g., date format, environment tagged) would be helpful.

I'll loop in Marissa from CS for any logistics and Vanessa from security to coordinate redactions.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alicia Rivera <security@bluewaterhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG artifacts consolidation and verification request

Hi Logan —

Thanks — this list looks right and matches what our InfoSec team usually pulls. A couple of clarifying notes:

1) SOC 2: we accept a manager-level SOC 2 Type II report as long as the scope covers processing of customer data (you can confirm in the cover letter). If the report includes third-party subservice details, please call that out.

2) Pen test: we will accept an executive summary / remediation status matrix with critical/important findings redacted. We can request the full report through our legal team if needed (NDA + limited distribution).

3) ISO: a copy of the certificate plus a short attestation letter (1 paragraph) stating scope is sufficient.

4) Security deck: high-level diagrams only (no internal IP or hardcoded hosts).

We need the artifacts uploaded to a secure transfer link. Can you provide one, or would you prefer us to send a temporary SFTP for upload?

Also, please include a one-page manifest listing file names, document dates, and contact for follow-ups.

Regards,
Alicia Rivera
Director of Information Security, Bluewater Health
security@bluewaterhealth.com

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the checklist and the specifics. We will prepare the items as you outlined. Logistics notes below:

- Upload link: https://secure-upload.redwood.ai/bluewater/txn-98234 (expires in 7 days). We will post the files there; if you prefer SFTP, let me know and we'll arrange.
- Manifest: attached (Redwood-SIG-Manifest.csv) — includes filenames, creation dates, document owner, and redaction notes.
- SOC 2: we'll provide the manager-level report with a cover letter confirming scope (processing, retention, backup).
- Pen test: we'll upload an executive summary and a remediation matrix; full technical report is available under NDA if Bluewater requires it.
- ISO: will include the ISO27001 certificate and a one-paragraph attestation.
- Deck: high-level security overview deck (pptx) that contains network diagrams with no internal hostnames.

Planned upload window: Tue 20 Jul 17:00 - 20:00 PDT. If that doesn't work for you, we can move to Wed morning.

Action items for Bluewater: please confirm that the secure link works for you and whether you require an NDA to access the pen test full report.

Thanks,
Logan
